'''Beray''' was a location on the [[Keshtah Minor]] continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] during [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]]. It housed a [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Beray faction|faction]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], to which the [[Slippery Hilts|father]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Caretaker]] [[Varner Hilts]] belonged.

==Behind the scenes==
While the location of Beray is mentioned in the [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets]]'', what kind of location it is&mdash;[[City/Legends|city]], landform, or otherwise&mdash;is not specified.
